Loading the data, packages 

```{r}

library(multiverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(broom)
library(lme4)



my_data = read_csv("C:/ELTE_ST/Additional_research_activity/gamedev/Schweinsberg/data/edge1.1.csv")

game = multiverse()


particip_data_duplicates = my_data |> 
  dplyr::select(!Order:Number.Characters)|> 
  group_by(ThreadId, Id) %>%
  summarize(across(Type:ContributionsbyAuthor,  ~ paste(unique(.x), collapse = "; "))) 
        
 particip_data_filt = particip_data_duplicates |>
  filter(if_any(Type:ContributionsbyAuthor, ~ grepl(";", .x)))
 
 my_data = anti_join(my_data, particip_data_filt,  by = c("ThreadId", "Id"))
 
 my_data = my_data |> 
   mutate(percent_by_author = ContributionsbyAuthor/ DebateSize, .after = ContributionsbyAuthor)
 
 particip_data_clean = my_data |> 
   dplyr::select(!Order:Number.Characters)|> 
  group_by(ThreadId, Id) %>%
  summarize(across(Type:ContributionsbyAuthor, unique))

my_data_n = my_data |> 
  group_by(ThreadId) |> 
  dplyr::select(!Live) |> 
  summarise(across(Type:UniqueFemaleParticipation, unique))

```



Attempt on trying a data_filtering decision with the multiverse 

```{multiverse default-m-1, inside = game}



my_data_st1 = my_data |> 
  dplyr::select(branch(level, 
                       "participant" ~ !c(Order:Number.Characters), 
                       "conversation" ~ !Live )) |> 
  group_by(ThreadId, branch(level, 
                  "participant" ~ Id, 
                  "conversation" ~ NULL)) |> 
  summarise(branch(level, 
                          "participant" ~ across(Type:percent_by_author, unique),
                          "conversation" ~ across(Type:UniqueFemaleParticipation, unique)))


parameters(game)


```


Few plots, just to check whether it works
```{multiverse default-m-2, inside = game}

my_data_variables = my_data_st1 |> 
  select(branch(dv_iv,
    "ContributionsbyAuthor_UniqueFemaleContributors" %when% (level == "participant") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, ContributionsbyAuthor, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "ContributionsbyAuthor_UniqueFemaleParticipation" %when% (level == "participant") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, ContributionsbyAuthor, UniqueFemaleParticipation, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "ContributionsbyAuthor_FemaleContributions" %when% (level == "participant") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, ContributionsbyAuthor, Female_Contributions, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),

    "percent_by_author_UniqueFemaleContributors" %when% (level == "participant") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, percent_by_author, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "percent_by_author_UniqueFemaleParticipation" %when% (level == "participant") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, percent_by_author, UniqueFemaleParticipation, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "percent_by_author_FemaleContributions" %when% (level == "participant") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, percent_by_author, Female_Contributions, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),

    "FemaleParticipation_UniqueFemaleContributors" %when% (level == "conversation") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, FemaleParticipation, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "FemaleParticipation_UniqueFemaleParticipation" %when% (level == "conversation") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, FemaleParticipation, UniqueFemaleParticipation, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "FemaleParticipation_FemaleContributions" %when% (level == "conversation") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, FemaleParticipation, Female_Contributions, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),

    "FemaleContributions_UniqueFemaleContributors" %when% (level == "conversation") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, Female_Contributions, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "FemaleContributions_UniqueFemaleParticipation" %when% (level == "conversation") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, Female_Contributions, UniqueFemaleParticipation, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors)))



```


```{multiverse default-m-3, inside = game}
my_data_filtered = my_data_variables |> 
  filter(branch(n_female_male, 
                "only_female" ~ UniqueFemaleContributors >= 1, 
                "female_and_male" ~ UniqueFemaleContributors >= 1 & UniqueMaleContributors >= 1))



```


```{multiverse default-m-4, inside = game}
my_data_filtered2 = my_data_filtered |> 
  filter(branch(questions, 
                "questions_and_comments" ~ Type == Type, 
                "only_comments" ~ Type == 2))


```
